instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app fails. FAIL packages/excalidraw/tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx > sticky notes > editing > routes a top pick to the label and the sticky default while editing a note. AssertionError: expected '#1e1e1e' to be '#e03131'. At tests/stickyNotes.test.tsx:604 `expect(getElement(label.id).strokeColor).toBe(RED);` after double-clicking a note labelled "hi" and clicking the red top pick with no selection made by the user. That test passed before this change and must keep passing unchanged.

Cause: textWysiwyg.tsx:1384 calls editable.select() when an editor opens on existing text (autoSelect), so the textarea already holds a whole-text selection the user did not make. actionChangeStrokeColor's new branch takes that for a selection and writes a range, instead of today's base-colour path.

Required fix, in actionChangeStrokeColor only (the first caller of changeTextStyleAttribute, in its perform): when the element being edited has no textStyleRanges and the selection covers all of its originalText (start 0, end equal to originalText.length), skip the range branch and take today's base-colour path, so the sticky note ink sync and the defaults run as they do today. A partial selection, and any selection on an element that already has ranges, still applies a range. Do not change actionChangeTextHighlight or the clear action, and do not change changeTextStyleAttribute's signature or behaviour for them: a highlight has no base value, so a whole-text selection stays a range there.
